### Host + smokes

- Host toolchain: `drawio` **30.3.13** (brew cask); Graphviz **15.1.0** (`dot` / `tred`).
- Smokes: `validate.py` 0 errors/0 warnings; `shapesearch.py "aws lambda"` OK; PNG export 800×408 OK.

## Host Prerequisites

| Tool | Required for | Install |
| --- | --- | --- |
| draw.io desktop CLI (`drawio` ≥ 30 recommended) | PNG/SVG/PDF/JPG export, Mermaid→drawio | `brew install --cask drawio` |
| Graphviz (`dot`, optional `tred`) | Large-graph autolayout | `brew install graphviz` |
| Python 3 | Bundled scripts | System / uv |

Without the CLI, the skill can still emit `.drawio` XML and diagrams.net browser-fallback URLs.

## Safety Notes

- **Credentials:** none required for core generation/export.
- **Network:** optional logo CDN fetch and diagrams.net fragment URLs; core authoring offline.
- **Files:** project reads for code/IaC visualization; diagram writes; optional `~/.drawio-skill` style presets.
- **Live action:** live terraform/docker/k8s importers and PR/timelapse tools can leak sensitive topology — invoke deliberately with redaction.
- **MCP / daemons / hooks:** none in the skill package; do not auto-start extras from this catalog row.
- **Secrets:** never commit secrets, tokens, private keys, connection strings, or raw cloud state dumps into diagrams or the repo.

## Dedupe / Routing

| Prefer | When |
| --- | --- |
| **drawio-skill** | Editable `.drawio`, official AWS/Azure/GCP/K8s shapes, swimlanes, strict UML/C4, desktop CLI export |
| `excalidraw-skill` | Casual whiteboard / hand-drawn look |
| `pretty-mermaid` / `utility-mermaid-diagrams` | Mermaid as git-native diagrams-as-code |
| `architecture-diagram` / `archify` | Standalone HTML/SVG architecture art without draw.io |
| `visual-explainer` | Self-contained HTML technical explainers |
| `draw-thing` | Local AI **image** generation (not diagrams) |
